comment.body:
Thanks for reporting that KeyboardManagerEngine stops after running for a long time. The report is from 0.85.1 and does not say how the exit was observed or what stops working. Could you please:
1. Retest on PowerToys 0.100.2 or newer and note the approximate time from launch until the problem occurs.
2. Describe the user-visible effect and how you confirmed the engine exited; also say whether restarting Keyboard Manager restores remapping.
3. If it happens again on the current build, comment `/bugreport` immediately afterward.
This will distinguish an unexpected engine exit from a remapping symptom without assuming a crash cause.
